summary: A 1938 BC-301 tower on Baldy Mountain above Happy Camp replaced a 1919 lookout house; a 1974 hire reportedly at this site, Kathy Shoopman, became a 48-year Klamath lookout before dying in the 2022 McKinney Fire.

facts.design: California Region 5 Plan BC-301 cab on a 10-foot enclosed timber tower
facts.agency: US Forest Service - Klamath National Forest

events.note: Telephone line built from Happy Camp to the lookout site; John Jackson recorded as watchman
Wilbur "Baldy Billy" Martin began a multi-season tenure as lookout, lasting to 1923; David Cuddihy resigned the same year citing altitude and heart trouble

A 'standard lookout house' (~14 ft square, 25 ft high) was planned starting that May and finished that October by Guard Effman and lookout Martin. This structure predates and is distinct from the surviving 1938 tower
Current BC-301 cab on a 10-foot timber tower built, per NHLR 'Built' field

Kathy Shoopman reportedly took her first fire-lookout post here, beginning a nearly 50-year career on Klamath National Forest lookouts; the cited article names the site 'Bald Mountain Lookout, west of Happy Camp' (slightly different name than this record, though the location description matches)
Added to the National Historic Lookout Register October 27, 2019, nominated by Brad Eells

sources.title: Woman killed in McKinney Fire identified as Klamath National Forest employee

notes_for_editor: The 1916-1923 staffing/construction detail comes from an enthusiast compilation site (californialookouts.weebly.com) that cites period Siskiyou County newspapers and a 1952 USC&GS data sheet; I could not verify those primary sources directly, only the compiler's summary of them, so treat names/dates in events for 1916-1923 as secondhand. The NHLR-dated 1938 tower and the 1919 lookout house are almost certainly two different structures on the same peak (record's 'built: 1938' event refers only to the surviving tower) - worth a note on the tower page if the editor wants to preserve both construction dates. Several undated NHLR photos (a 'California Plan 4A Cabin' and a 'Tree Platform') suggest yet other structures/eras on this site that no source dates; not added as events since no year is given. Kathy Shoopman's start-year lookout is called 'Bald Mountain Lookout' in the Action News Now piece but multiple other outlets (ABC10, Yahoo/AP, KTVL) place her first post at 'Baldy Mountain Lookout... west of Happy Camp', matching this record; I treated it as the same site given the matching location description, but flagging the name discrepancy. No source found addresses current public access, trail, or drive-up status, so visit/access facts were left out rather than guessed.
